title: Can't pinch rhythm from our sun No cadence in forced chords of life's chores for sounds bounce on the dead drop of a down strum #smallpoems #ukulele
summary: Can't pinch rhythm from our sun No cadence in forced chords of life's chores for sounds bounce on the dead drop of a down strum #smallpoems #ukulele
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Can't pinch
    rhythm from
our sun

No cadence
in forced chords
of life's chores

  for sounds
bounce on
    the dead
drop
of a
   down
       strum
#smallpoems
#ukulele
